title: Shubie Campground

services.name: No other campground in Halifax
services.desc: Shubie Campground is a fantastic destination for families looking to enjoy the great outdoors, just outside of the city. With a variety of activities that cater to all ages, it's the perfect spot for creating unforgettable memories this summer! In this blog post, we’ll explore the best family-friendly activities available at Shubie Campground, ensuring your trip is packed with fun and adventure. Canoeing on the Shubie Canal and Lake Charles is a peaceful and scenic way to explore the natural beauty of Shubie Campground. The calm waters make it an ideal activity for families with children.
